scenario.title: Concierge Extreme: Rapid Multi-Thread Orchestration
scenario.background: A high-pressure professional delegates a large volume of personal and work tasks to an AI concierge, spanning health, home, work, and social life. The user frequently switches topics and introduces complex dependencies that must be tracked across threads. Unexpected disruptions force continuous replanning and careful branch control.
scenario.user_profile: Busy senior product manager in San Francisco with a demanding job and many parallel personal obligations. Detail-oriented but time-starved, expects the AI to remember prior commitments, anticipate conflicts, and deliver decisive, structured options.
scenario.assistant_profile: An AI concierge with robust branching control: creates and maintains threads, proactively flags conflicts, proposes MERGE for cross-topic synthesis and SPLIT for alternative paths, and keeps a consistent calendar and budget ledger. Communicates succinctly, confirms assumptions, and adapts rapidly to changing constraints.

threads.intent: Design and maintain an 8–12 week fitness plan aligned with schedule and nutrition.
Rebalance and optimize investment portfolio while freeing cash for near-term expenses.
Plan and execute a budget-conscious kitchen renovation with minimal downtime.
Coordinate parents’ medical checkups, logistics, and diet considerations.
Drive Product Launch for Nimbus 2.0 with marketing and stakeholder readiness.
Deliver Q3 quarterly report on accelerated timeline.
Establish Spanish learning cadence with tutor and app practice.
Manage dog Mocha’s vaccinations, meds, grooming, and contingencies.
Plan weekend social events and outdoor activities without conflicts.
Schedule car service and recalls, coordinating with transport needs.
Early-stage wedding planning and venue scouting with partner Alex.

global_requirements: Assume scenario anchor date is Monday 2025-10-20; all dates/times are local to America/Los_Angeles.
Maintain a single master calendar across all threads; always check for and flag conflicts before confirming.
Persist and reuse thread IDs exactly as defined; never invent new IDs.
Use MERGE when the user requests cross-topic synthesis (e.g., integrated schedules, budgets, or nutrition across threads).
Use SPLIT when presenting alternative plans or when a disruption creates divergent options to evaluate.
Track budgets per thread and a global roll-up; call out changes (e.g., renovation budget cuts) and re-scope accordingly.
Preserve stakeholder names and vendor details consistently (e.g., Nora, Samir, Ivy; Oak&Nail; GreenPaws; Bay AutoCare).
If critical information is missing (e.g., exact times, insurance numbers), ask concise clarifying questions while proposing reasonable defaults.
When unexpected events occur, immediately re-evaluate dependencies and propose a re-baselined plan.
Assume user can travel between SF and San Jose; include travel times in integrated schedules.
All weekend social items are flexible unless explicitly marked fixed; medical and work deadlines take precedence.

user_goals: Fitness: Set an 8-week plan (start week of 2025-10-20); schedule Tue/Thu/Sat 06:30–07:30; budget $120/month; target Turkey Trot 5K on 2025-11-27.
Investing: Rebalance to 70/30; 401k $180k, taxable $45k, cash $12k; deploy $10k to VTI/VXUS; continue $1,500 monthly DCA; free $5–8k for renovation.
Renovation: Request two bids; budget $15k; target start 2025-11-03; minimize kitchen downtime; shortlist tile and appliance packages.
Parents' health: Book Mom (cardio) and Dad (urology) the week of 2025-11-05 mornings in San Jose; arrange transport; note low-sodium diet.
Work A launch: Create launch checklist for 2025-11-15; hold cross-functional syncs; asset deadlines.
Work B report: Block 2 hours daily next week; confirm due 2025-10-31; outline slide/data needs.
Language: Set Tue/Thu 20:00–20:45 with Tutor Carla; confirm first session 2025-10-23.
Dog health: Schedule vaccines on 2025-10-28 at GreenPaws; set daily meds reminder 09:00; confirm walker Leo M/W/F 12:00.
Social weekend: Book Sat 2025-10-25 19:00 dinner at Luna Bistro with Jess & Omar; plan Sun 09:00 hike at Lands End.
Car maintenance: Book oil + brake service Fri 2025-10-24 16:00 at Bay AutoCare; ask about loaner/ride; estimate $450.
Wedding: Shortlist 3 venues (incl. Seacliff Gardens); budget $25k; guest list ~120; target 2026-09-12; schedule 1 venue tour on 2025-11-02.
escalations: Partner Alex mentions parents-in-law might visit early November; request to keep first two weekends relatively free.
Boss Dana expects a pre-brief this month; time TBD.
chunks.notes: User jumps across all threads to seed branches with concrete data. Assistant must create initial stubs per thread, confirm times, and identify any immediate conflicts (e.g., car service vs report blocks). No merges yet; focus on rapid thread creation and state capture.
